code.description: Código estable del error de CAMPO (no es el `code` del problema). Valores conocidos, que se agregan y no se renombran: required, invalid_value, out_of_range, invalid_key, invalid_token, invalid_amount, unsupported_currency, unknown_field, unknown_parameter, not_allowed_for_method, payment_method_unavailable, fee_schedule_missing, exceeds_refundable, contains_card_number, card_number_detected, invalid_json, too_large, already_registered, invalid_cursor, must_be_after_period_from; webhooks (field url): invalid_url, https_required, credentials_in_url, port_not_allowed, internal_name, private_address, unresolvable; webhooks (field enabled_events): unknown_event_type; webhooks (field endpoint): limit_reached.
